options.text: Both look lustrous; shine alone does not prove that a material is a metal.
Only the spoon can look shiny, because only metals are lustrous.
The bangle must be a metal because it shines.
A material is lustrous only if light passes through it.

stem:
Preeti holds a shiny steel spoon and a shiny plastic bangle up to the light.

Which claim is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Lustrous means shiny in appearance. Shine can appear on non-metals too, so lustre alone is not enough evidence that a material is a metal.
